```{r cli}
#' @title rnx2rtkp Wrapper Class
#' @description wrapper for the `rnx2rtkp` CLI tool for rnx post-processing.
#' @param cli_path path to the `rnx2rtkp` executable
#' @param help Flag to print help
#' @param files a list of input files
#' @param config_file
rnx2rtkp <- function(
  cli_path = "rnx2rtkp",
  help = FALSE,
  files,
  config_file = NULL,
  output_file,
  time_start,
  time_end,
  time_interval,
  mode,
  mask,
  system,
  freqeuncies,
  threshold,
  backward = FALSE,
  forward = FALSE,
  instantaneous = FALSE,
  hold = FALSE,
  baseline,
  e,a,n,g,t,u,
  decimals,
  separator,
  r,
  l,
  y,
  debug,
  rover,
  base,
  version
  ){
  args <- character()
  if(help){ args <- append(args, '-?') }
  if (!all(file.exists(files))) {
    stop("Input file(s) do not exist: ", paste(files[!file.exists(files)], collapse = ", "))
  }
  if(!is.null(config_file)){
    if(!file.exists(config_file)){
      stop("Config file does not exist: ", config_file)
    }
    args <- append(args, paste('-k', config_file))
  }
  if(output_file){ args <- append(args, paste('-o', output_file)) }
  if(time_start){ args <- append(args, paste('-ts', time_start)) }
  if(time_end){ args <- append(args, paste('-te', time_end)) }
  if(time_interval){ args <- append(args, paste('-ti', time_interval)) }
  args <- append(args, paste('-p', mode))
  args <- append(args, paste('-m', mask))
  args <- append(args, paste('-sys', system))
  args <- append(args, paste('-f', freqeuncies))
  args <- append(args, paste('-v', threshold))
  if(backward){  args <- append(args,'-b')}
  if(forward){  args <- append(args,'-c')}
  if(backward){  args <- append(args,'-b')}
  if(instantaneous){  args <- append(args,'-i')}
  if(hold){  args <- append(args,'-h')}
  args <- append(args, paste('-bl', baseline))
  if(e){  args <- append(args,'-e')}
  if(a){  args <- append(args,'-a')}
  if(n){  args <- append(args,'-n')}
  if(g){  args <- append(args,'-g')}
  if(t){  args <- append(args,'-t')}
  if(u){  args <- append(args,'-u')}
  if(decimals){ args <- append(args, paste('-d', decimals)) }
  if(separator){ args <- append(args, paste('-s', separator)) }
  args <- append(args, paste('-r', r))
  args <- append(args, paste('-l', l))
  if(y){ args <- append(args, paste('-y', y)) }
  if(x){ args <- append(args, paste('-x', x)) }
  if(rover){ args <- append(args, paste('--rover', rover)) }
  if(base){ args <- append(args, paste('--base', base)) }

  # TODO also provide return code
  output <- system2(cli_path, args, stdout= TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
  return(output)
}

```


```{r demo-cli}
cli_path <- '../../RTKLIB/bin/rnx2rtkp'
rnx2rtkp(cli_path= cli_path, files = c('main.Rmd'))
```
